recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片在骨小樑之間可見淋巴聚集，其中有淡染的圓形中心（生發中心）被深色小淋巴球環繞，周圍仍有三系造血與巨核細胞，符合骨髓內反應性淋巴濾泡（germinal center）。
features: Hypercellular marrow between bony trabeculae with preserved trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
Central lymphoid aggregate containing pale-staining rounded zones (germinal centers)
Germinal centers rimmed by a darker cuff of small mantle-zone lymphocytes
Aggregates are well circumscribed and non-paratrabecular
No fibrosis or effacement of the surrounding marrow
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, including scattered megakaryocytes, between bony trabeculae. A well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular lymphoid aggregate contains pale-staining germinal centers surrounded by a darker cuff of small mantle lymphocytes. The adjacent hematopoietic marrow is not effaced. Findings are consistent with a reactive lymphoid follicle with germinal center formation in the marrow, as can be seen in autoimmune disease or other chronic immune stimulation.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma typically forms paratrabecular aggregates that lack well-formed germinal centers with polarity and tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-positive.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma aggregates are often multiple, larger, poorly circumscribed or intrasinusoidal and composed of a monotypic B-cell population.
Hodgkin involvement shows fibrosis with a mixed inflammatory background and CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells rather than an organized follicle.
